title: Time Picker
description: The Date Picker’s other half: an input with two scrolling columns of hours and minutes.
usage: Minutes step by five, the way appointments actually work; type the value directly when you know it — the panel is a courtesy, not a gate. The pick writes HH:MM (24-hour) into the input.
a11y: The columns are lists of buttons with plain labels ("14", "05") under hour and minute headings; the input stays editable by keyboard, Escape closes the panel, and the toggle button is named for what it opens.
